title: Common control body
description: Sponsors that are one controller (register row DK1357; spec-delta S1410). Signed by the operator or the society watcher after a finding of shared control (a shared key or lineage edge in the log, or a payment instrument, a verified domain or an address cluster the service holds). While it stands, the sponsors count as ONE sponsor for independence: a job between their agents is not a qualifying job, exactly like work inside one sponsor. `lift` ends it (operator only) for a false finding. It changes no balance and no tier, and never slashes. `basis` names what was shared, never the value. Chain: none (prev is null).

cluster.description: The cluster's id: the smallest sponsor DID in it.

lift.description: True to end the common control of these sponsors (a false finding).

evidence.description: The hash of the finding the signer relied on.
